channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio diz que eleição 'é o fim da era do PT', e Lula diz que 2º turno mostrará 'fotografia real do Brasil'; siga
item.description: Flávio Dória claims the 2026 election signals the end of the PT era, while Lula says the runoff will reveal the true portrait of Brazil. BBC News Brasil provides live coverage of results and analysis from the first round.

item.title: Votos em Garotinho no RJ contam como válidos até decisão final do TSE
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, ruled that votes for Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos) for governor of Rio de Janeiro will be counted as valid until the plenary reviews the registration of his candidacy. The ruling was issued after the deadline for rejection, keeping the votes pending until a final decision.

item.title: Nikolas consegue eleger bancada de deputados federais e estaduais pelo país
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) was reelected federal deputy and became the most-voted candidate in Brazilian history, surpassing Eduardo Bolsonaro's record. His victory helped form a bench of federal and state deputies across the country.

item.title: Apenas oito de 22 ex-ministros do governo Lula vencem nas urnas
item.description: Only 8 of Lula's 22 former ministers were elected to Congress, showing weak legislative performance. Alckmin advances to the presidential runoff with Lula.

item.title: Trump chama Brasil de Índia nas redes e elogia processo eleitoral
item.description: Donald Trump posted on Truth Social congratulating 'India' for the quick announcement of election results, but the message appears to refer to Brazil, since India has not recently held presidential elections and these are indirect in the country. The confusion sparked comments about Trump's relationship with emerging countries. The post highlights U.S. interest in international elections.

item.title: Trump troca Brasil por Índia ao elogiar rapidez na apuração das eleições
item.description: Donald Trump praised the speed of vote counting but seemingly confused Brazil with India when commenting on the Brazilian electoral process on his Truth Social platform. The U.S. president highlighted the quick results in contrast to the American system, causing confusion about which country was being referenced.

item.title: Trump confunde Brasil com Índia ao comentar apuração eleitoral
item.description: Donald Trump confused Brazil with India when commenting on the Brazilian election results, initially posting an incorrect version on his Truth Social profile. The post was later corrected to reference Brazil and used to criticize the U.S. electoral process, alleging fraud without evidence. Trump also advocated for restrictions on mail-in voting ahead of the U.S. midterm elections in November 2026.

item.title: Eleições 2026: quem foi mais votado em Passos (MG) no 1º turno
item.description: In the 2026 elections in Passos (MG), Flavio Bolsonaro (PL) led the vote for president with 51.36%, ahead of Lula (PT) at 38.86%. For governor, Cleitinho Azevedo (REPUBLICANOS) won with 61.56% of the votes. Domingos Savio Campos Resende (PL) was the top Senate candidate with 28.59%, while Diego Rodrigo De Oliveira (PSD) led the five local legislative races.

item.title: Eleições 2026: quem foi mais votado em Pará de Minas (MG) no 1º turno
item.description: In Pará de Minas (MG), presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro (PL) led with 62.19% of the votes, followed by Lula (PT) at 27.27%. For governor, Cleitinho Azevedo (REPUBLICANOS) secured 67.88%, while Patrus Ananias (PT) reached 15.49%. In the Senate race, Domingos Savio Campos Resende (PL) was the top vote-getter with 34.53%, and for the federal chamber, Nikolas Ferreira De Oliveira (PL) led with 42.63%.

item.title: Eleições em Nova Serrana (MG): veja a apuração do 1º turno
item.description: In Nova Serrana (MG), Flavio Bolsonaro (PL) led the presidential vote with 71.84%, followed by Lula (PT) with 21.25%. In the state race, Cleitinho Azevedo (REPUBLICANOS) won with 80.58% for governor, while in the Senate, Domingos Savio Campos Resende (PL) secured 39.99% of the votes. The elections took place on October 4, 2026.

item.title: Eleições em Muriaé (MG): veja a apuração do 1º turno

item.title: Eleições 2026: quem foi mais votado em Coronel Fabriciano (MG) no 1º turno

item.title: Eleições em Três Rios (RJ): veja a apuração do 1º turno

Eduardo Paes (PSD) leads the gubernatorial race with 46.52%, while Carlos Francisco Portinho (PL) and Benedita Souza Da Silva Sampaio (PT) compete for the Senate.
